days.title: Cascades and Basin
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hauptfälle
stops.detail: After a steep torrent section follow the well-known seven-stage main falls, which plunge on a stretch of approx. 230 meters from about 805 m to 713 m above sea level.

stops.name: Wasserfallkessel
stops.detail: The cirque-like forms including the waterfall basin likely received their final shaping during the high glacial period of the Würm ice age, while the lower valley steps were shaped only in older, more extensive glaciations.

days.title: Lake and Mountain Entrances
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bergsee
stops.detail: The Triberg waterfall basin lies, together with the neighboring mountain lake, in a row of ice-age cirque forms that are typically recessed into the northeastern slope of the Schönwald plateau.

stops.name: Scheffelplatz
stops.detail: They have five entrances: in the city center directly on the B 500, at the Bergsee, at Scheffelplatz, on the Adelheid and behind the Asklepios Clinic.
